label: Locate market equilibrium from schedules or curves
steps: Compare quantity demanded and quantity supplied across prices (or plot both curves).
Find the price where quantity demanded equals quantity supplied (or the intersection of the two curves).
Read off the equilibrium price and equilibrium quantity.
success_criteria: A price-quantity pair where Qd = Qs; equilibrium price and quantity identified.

scope.text: Introductory economics; markets for goods and services
